name: Missouri
sources: MO DOR 2026 withholding formula (as published in USDA NFC bulletin 2026/1773783048): 2026 rate chart, 0% to 4.7% with brackets every $1,348; standard deduction equals the 2026 federal amounts
MO DOR Form MO-1040 (2025): federal income tax deduction chart (35/25/15/5/0% by Missouri AGI, cap $5,000 or $10,000 combined); a separate tax is computed for each spouse
MO DOR Form MO-A (2025) Part 2: itemize only if itemized federally; federal Schedule A less state and local income taxes
MO DOR Capital Gains Subtraction FAQs (dor.mo.gov/faq/taxation/individual/capital-gains-subtraction.html): 100% of federally reported capital gains subtracted (H.B. 594, 2025)
provisional: 2026 brackets are from the DOR's 2026 withholding formula; the 2026 MO-1040 rate chart is not out yet
Property-tax cap uses the 2026 federal SALT cap ($40,400; $20,200 married filing separately) without its phase-down above $505,000 of income
notes: Missouri's federal tax deduction is sized by Missouri income after the capital gains subtraction; here it uses federal AGI, so it may be slightly low for households with large gains.
